confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Madrid price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages; no web sources were used for the price anchors. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are the most grounded; cocktail and wine are partly inferred from local beer and bar pricing; accommodation is least certain and varies with neighbourhood, booking lead time and July demand. EUR prices were converted at an approximate general-knowledge rate, not a live quote. The 14 October 2026 FX value comes from two search runs whose RBA-attributed snippets agree; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a direct input. Restaurant and cafe levels are based on general knowledge of Spanish capital-city pricing and are broadly in line with similar large southern European capitals such as Barcelona and Lisbon; accommodation is set to Spanish metropolitan capital summer rates.
